items.claim: Sal Kukul looked amazing and has potential star power in the division.
items.quote: Sal Kukul looked amazing man. They got a potential superstar in their hands here. I shouldn't say superstar superstar is like Conor McGregor. They have a potential star in their hands here with Sal Kukul.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson is matched against Mackenzie Dern, and Dern is viewed as a better version than Robertson.
items.quote: I think Robertson's getting a unanimous decision win. Okay, Dern, I'll give you full marks if you pull it off. I'm not saying Robertson can win the fight, but I just think again, Dern is like a better version than Robertson.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern is a better version of a fighter than Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: Dern is like a better version than Robertson.

items.claim: Suarez likely wins against either Dern or Robertson as long as she can utilize her wrestling.
items.quote: I think Suarez, if she fights either Dern or Robertson, she probably wins that fight as long as she can utilize the wrestling.

items.claim: Kamaru Usman's best days are behind him based on his performance in the Dricus Du Plessis fight.
items.quote: I think it was pretty obvious in the DDP fight that Usman's best days are behind him.

items.claim: Ian Garry against Islam will be a more competitive fight than Kamaru Usman against Islam because Usman is much older and not the same fighter.
items.quote: Ian Garry against Islam is going to be a more competitive fight than Kamaru Usman and Islam. And if you don't think that, then you're not paying attention. Usman is much older, not the same fighter.

items.claim: The late stoppage in the Bobby Green fight negatively affected Jalin Turner.
items.quote: I believe the late stoppage in the Bobby Green fight also affected Jalin Turner. He said so after his UFC 300 fight.
